purpose: Requirements for task-based document search over a ToC, including recall-first results, pre-search rebuild checks, failure handling, and the required fields of search results.
summary: FR-006: search finds documents relevant to a task, prioritizing no omissions and including doubtful documents
Key selection: --key searches that ToC, and omitting it searches the reserved key all in single mode
Missing ToC: search is not run and an initial build with an Index target specification is required
Existing ToC: rebuild necessity is checked from the stored Index target specification before searching
When rebuild is needed, the user chooses between rebuilding first or searching the existing ToC as is
Confirmation shows counts per change type and the number of documents needing AI summary generation
Undeterminable rebuild necessity (permissions, read errors, unreadable specification) stops search as a failure
Searching a stale ToC notifies possible staleness and does not reconfirm the ToC as current
Search results include document ID, recorded path, reason for relevance, sections, and ToC state
AC-019: acceptance condition for the pre-search ToC rebuild confirmation
tasks: Implementing or changing the document search feature
Designing the search interface and its result format
Implementing failure handling when rebuild necessity cannot be determined
Writing or reviewing tests for search acceptance condition AC-019
Finding relevant documents before starting a task via another skill
